note.es: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Racion de crecimiento de cerdos en pellet (15-17 % de proteina), saco de 25 kg; el precio por saco se pasa a tonelada (x40). Serie mensual en dolares canadienses. Cambio de unidad hecho por Dehesa Index con aritmetica exacta, sin estimar nada.
note.en: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Pelleted pig grower ration (15-17 % protein), 25 kg bag; the price per bag is converted to a tonne (x40). Monthly series in Canadian dollars. Unit conversion done by Dehesa Index with exact arithmetic; nothing is estimated.

note.it: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Razione di accrescimento per suini in pellet (15-17 % di proteine), sacco da 25 kg; il prezzo per sacco è convertito in tonnellata (x40).
